versions.content: Aging for event memory entries Description: The diagnostic in AUTOSAR shall support aging for event memory entries to remove entries from the event memory which have not failed for a specific number of operating cycles. Rationale: Remove information from fault memory that is not relevant for a repair action. Use Case: Network timeout fault that has been detected, but is not in active state any more. AppliesTo: CP, AP Dependencies: – Supporting Material: –
